source_caption:
📺 Breaking Bad (2008–2013)

Breaking Bad follows Walter White, a struggling high school chemistry teacher in Albuquerque, New Mexico, whose life changes dramatically after he is diagnosed with lung cancer. Desperate to secure his family’s financial future, Walter teams up with his former student, Jesse Pinkman, to manufacture and sell methamphetamine. What begins as a desperate attempt to make money quickly spirals into a dangerous criminal empire filled with ruthless drug dealers, powerful enemies, shocking betrayals, and life-changing consequences. As Walter becomes increasingly consumed by power, pride, and ambition, his transformation from an ordinary teacher into the feared criminal known as Heisenberg threatens everything he once wanted to protect. Combining intense suspense, unforgettable characters, brilliant storytelling, and unexpected twists, the series explores morality, greed, family, and the devastating consequences of dangerous choices.

🎭 Genre: Crime • Drama • Thriller

⭐ IMDb: 9.5/10

⏱️ Runtime: ~47 minutes per episode • 5 seasons • 62 episodes

🎥 Creator: Vince Gilligan

🏆 Recognition: Starring Bryan Cranston, Aaron Paul, and Anna Gunn, the series won 16 Primetime Emmy Awards, including Outstanding Drama Series. Widely regarded as one of the greatest television shows ever made, Breaking Bad became a cultural phenomenon and inspired the acclaimed spin-off Better Call Saul.

📺 Where to Watch: Netflix. Availability varies by region.

source_details.synopsis: Breaking Bad is an American neo-Western crime drama television series created by Vince Gilligan for AMC. Set and filmed in Albuquerque, New Mexico, the series follows Walter White (Bryan Cranston), an overqualified high school chemistry teacher who, after being diagnosed with stage-three lung cancer, begins producing and selling methamphetamine with former student Jesse Pinkman (Aaron Paul) to secure his family's financial future. The series also stars Anna Gunn, Dean Norris, Betsy Brandt, RJ Mitte, Giancarlo Esposito, Bob Odenkirk, Jonathan Banks, Laura Fraser, and Jesse Plemons. Breaking Bad premiered on AMC on January 20, 2008, and concluded on September 29, 2013, after five seasons and 6
